title: feat: DetailView rendering optimization — hideEmpty, primaryField, summaryFields, responsive fix, collapseWhenEmpty, field renderer enhancements
body:
Platform DetailView renderer under-consumes existing spec capabilities, resulting in flat single-section layouts, static headers showing object type instead of record name, wasted space from empty fields, and premature multi-column breakpoints on tablet viewports.

### Types (`@object-ui/types`)
- `DetailViewSection.hideEmpty?: boolean` — filter null/undefined/empty-string fields; hide section when all filtered
- `DetailViewSchema.primaryField?: string` — resolve header title from `data[primaryField]`, fallback to `title`
- `DetailViewSchema.summaryFields?: string[]` — render as `<Badge>` beside header title

### DetailSection
- `hideEmpty` filtering before auto-layout, `return null` on empty section
- Responsive breakpoint fix: `sm:grid-cols-2` → `md:grid-cols-2`, `md:grid-cols-3` → `lg:grid-cols-3` (iPad+sidebar no longer triggers multi-column prematurely)

### DetailView header
- `data[primaryField]` as `<h1>` with `summaryFields` as accessible `<Badge aria-label>` elements

### RecordActivityTimeline
- `collapseWhenEmpty` prop suppresses "No activity recorded" chrome, shows only comment input

### RecordDetailView (console)
- Reads `objectDef.views?.form?.sections` for section grouping; fallback to flat field list
- Removed `columns: 2` hardcode — `autoLayout` infers from field count
- Auto-detects `primaryField` from `objectDef.primaryField` metadata, then `name`/`title` heuristic

### Field Renderer Enhancements (`@object-ui/fields`)
- **EmailCellRenderer**: `mailto:` link + hover copy-to-clipboard button
- **PhoneCellRenderer**: `tel:` link with call icon + hover copy-to-clipboard button
- **BooleanCellRenderer**: Destructive warning `Badge` for status fields (`active`, `is_active`, `enabled`, `is_enabled`, `verified`, `is_verified`) when value is `false` (e.g. "Active — Off"); `STATUS_FIELD_NAMES` extracted as maintainable `Set` constant
- Clipboard `.catch()` handlers for insecure contexts

```tsx
// Header now shows record name + key badges instead of static "Contact"
<DetailView schema={{
  type: 'detail-view',
  title: 'Contact',
  primaryField: 'name',
  summaryFields: ['status', 'department'],
  data: { name: 'Sarah Johnson', status: 'Active', department: 'Engineering' },
  sections: [{ title: 'Info', hideEmpty: true, fields: [...] }],
}} />
```

### Tests
- 11 new plugin-detail tests: `hideEmpty` filtering, empty section hiding, `primaryField`/`summaryFields` rendering, responsive breakpoint class assertions, `collapseWhenEmpty`, `autoLayout` undefined-columns regression
- 12 new field renderer tests: email copy button, phone icon+copy, boolean warning badge, empty value handling
- 194 total tests passing (94 plugin-detail + 100 field renderers)

### Storybook
- Added `PrimaryFieldWithBadges` and `HideEmptyFields` stories

> 
> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>平台级 DetailView 渲染优化：自动分组、空值隐藏、Header 智能化、响应式修正</issue_title>
> <issue_description>
> 
> ### 背景
> 
> 通过 CRM Contact 详情页（代表性用例）发现平台 DetailView 渲染引擎存在通用性短板——影响所有通过 schema 生成的对象详情页。**不涉及 spec 协议改动**，spec 现有能力（sections/collapsible/columns/highlights/responsive）已足够，问题在于 objectui 未充分消费。
> 
> ### 改动清单
> 
> #### 1. `RecordDetailView.tsx` — 复用 form sections + 删除 `columns: 2` 硬编码
> - **文件**: `apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx` L200-225
> - 当前将所有字段塞入单个 `Details` section 并硬编码 `columns: 2`
> - **改法**: 读取 `objectDef.views?.form?.sections` 生成分组；无配置时 fallback 但删除 columns 让 `autoLayout` 推断
> 
> #### 2. `DetailSection.tsx` — 实现 hideEmpty 空值字段过滤
> - **文件**: `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` L70-80
> - 当前空值统一渲染为 `-`，浪费空间
> - **改法**: `section.hideEmpty` 为 true 时过滤 null/undefined/空字符串字段；空 section 隐藏
> - **类型**: `packages/types/src/views.ts` `DetailViewSection` 加 `hideEmpty?: boolean`
> 
> #### 3. `DetailView.tsx` — Header 显示记录主属性 + 关键 Badge
> - **文件**: `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` L252
> - 当前 header 显示静态 `schema.title`（如 "Contact"），不显示实际记录名
> - **改法**: 
>   - `DetailViewSchema` 加 `primaryField?: string` + `summaryFields?: string[]`
>   - 渲染 `data[primaryField]` 为标题，`summaryFields` 渲染为 Badge
>   - `RecordDetailView` 自动从 objectDef 找 name/title 字段填入
> 
> #### 4. `RecordActivityTimeline` — 空态智能折叠
> - **文件**: `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` L287-294
> - 当前空态占满整个 Card + "No activity recorded"
> - **改法**: 空数据时最小化为仅评论输入框，增加 `collapseWhenEmpty` prop
> 
> #### 5. `DetailSection.tsx` — 响应式断点修正
> - **文件**: `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` L159-165
> - 当前 `sm:` (640px) 断点在 iPad+侧边栏场景下过早触发多列
> - **改法**: 改为 `md:grid-cols-2` / `lg:grid-cols-3`，或集成 `@object-ui/mobile` 的 `useBreakpoint()`
> 
> #### 6. 字段渲染器增强
> - **文件**: `packages/fields/` 各 CellRenderer
> - email → mailto + copy；phone → tel + call；boolean → 警告 Badge；经纬度 → 默认进 Metadata
> 
> ### 测试要求
> - `DetailSection.test.tsx`: hideEmpty 过滤、空 section 隐藏
> - `DetailView.test.tsx`: primaryField 标题渲染、summaryFields Badge
> - `autoLayout.test.ts`: columns undefined 时自动推断不回归
> - 响应式测试: 断点类名验证
> 
> ### 完成后
> - 更新 `ROADMAP.md`
> - 更新 Storybook `DetailView.stories.tsx` 展示新能力
> - 回归所有内置对象的 detail 页面一致性</issue_description>
